organisations.description: State-level legal aid — contact your state's SLSA
organisations.helpline: Contact your district legal services authority

organisations.name: National Consumer Helpline
organisations.description: Help with consumer complaints against goods and services

organisations.name: Ministry of Labour Helpline
organisations.description: Complaints about employment, wages, labour rights

organisations.name: Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA)
organisations.description: Complaints about real estate transactions and rental disputes in some states
